name: Half-angle slicing
definition: A two-pass per-slice rendering technique for volumetric shadows where slices are taken perpendicular to the half-angle vector between the eye and light directions, allowing a single slice to be rendered from both viewpoints.
summary: Half-angle slicing is a two-pass technique that renders volumetric shadows by orienting slices perpendicular to the half-angle vector, allowing shared geometry to compute both eye-composited color and light transmissivity efficiently.
